a1-review-4.R4.1 Airport:
Narrator: It's December the twenty-eighth. Tom is at the airport in São Paulo, and Ana is there to meet him.
Ana: Welcome back to São Paulo! How was the flight?
Tom: Long, but OK! Thanks for coming. Whose car is this? Is it new?
Ana: It's Marcos's car. Mine is at the mechanic. So, what do you want to do first?
Tom: First, I need some summer clothes! In Chicago it's minus ten degrees, and I only have sweaters and a coat.
Ana: No problem. There's a big mall near my house. You can try on some shorts and T-shirts there.
Ana: And tomorrow we're going to the supermarket. We're making a big dinner for New Year's Eve, and we don't have any rice. We need a lot of fruit too.
Tom: How many people are coming?
Ana: About twelve! My parents, Paulo, Grandma Lourdes and some friends. Paulo is bringing his robot, Buddy. He says it works now!
Tom: Will it play cards with Grandma this time?
Ana: Probably not! I think Grandma will win again.
Tom: And on New Year's Day?
Ana: We're going to the beach in Santos. But remember, you should use a lot of sunscreen. The sun is very strong here. And in the car, you must wear your seat belt!
Tom: Yes, doctor! Oh, and I want to save some money on this trip. Any tips?
Ana: Don't take taxis everywhere. You could take the subway with us. And don't worry about restaurants. You're eating at my house!
Tom: Perfect. I'm going to love this week!

a1-review-4.R4.3 Dialogues:
Narrator: Dialogue one.
Tom: Excuse me. Can I try on these shorts?
Woman: Of course. What size are you?
Tom: I'm a medium.
Woman: The changing rooms are over there.
Tom: Hmm... they don't fit. Do you have them in a large?
Woman: Yes, here you are.
Tom: Perfect. How much are they?
Woman: They're on sale, only eighty reais.
Tom: Great! I'll pay by card.
Narrator: Dialogue two.
Mia: Can you lend me twenty reais? I'm worried about money again.
Ana: Sure. But what should you do? You should make coffee at home!

Ana: Don't throw it away. You can repair it!
